findings.key_quote: Sales increased 17% in Q1 2026 compared to the comparable prior year period.
findings.justification: This passage directly states that sales (net sales) increased 17% in Q1 2026 (three months ended March 31, 2026) compared to the prior year period (Q1 2025, three months ended March 31, 2025). This is an observed result for the exact period in question and directly entails that net sales increased year over year.

E7 shows revenue of $181,519 million for Q1 2026 (2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31) and E8 shows revenue of $155,667 million for Q1 2025 (2025-01-01 to 2025-03-31). Since 181,519 > 155,667, this arithmetically demonstrates that net sales increased year over year for the quarter ended March 31, 2026.

This derived metric shows the year-over-year revenue growth rate for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 as approximately 16.6% (0.166 as a ratio). A positive growth rate directly entails that net sales increased year over year.

findings.key_quote: Sales increased 17% in Q1 2026 compared to the comparable prior year period.
findings.justification: This passage states that sales increased 17% in Q1 2026 compared to Q1 2025, which is an observed result showing positive year-over-year revenue growth for the exact period in question.

E7 shows revenue of $181,519 million for Q1 2026 and E8 shows revenue of $155,667 million for Q1 2025. The arithmetic calculation (181,519 - 155,667) / 155,667 = 0.166 or 16.6% growth, demonstrating positive year-over-year revenue growth.

This derived metric directly provides the year-over-year revenue growth rate for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 as approximately 16.6%, which is a positive increase and directly entails the assertion of revenue year-over-year growth increase.

findings.key_quote: AWS sales increased 28% in Q1 2026 compared to the comparable prior year period.
findings.justification: This passage provides information about AWS segment sales growth, which is a component of total net sales but does not by itself establish the consolidated net sales change without information about the other segments.

findings.key_quote: Operating income increased from $18.4 billion in Q1 2025 to $23.9 billion in Q1 2026.
findings.justification: This passage discusses operating income, which is a different measure than net sales. While it provides context about Amazon's financial performance, it does not directly address net sales changes.
